name: infostyle
description: Russian text editing in информационный стиль (Ilyahov, Sarycheva). Ships **infostyle** — a full edit pass over prose that starts from the reader's useful action and audience, then works structure, paragraph, sentence, word and presentation, with a stop-word catalogue (вводные, неопределённое, заумь, оценки, штампы), bureaucratese repairs, and a hard ban on inventing the facts that replace value judgements — and **infostyle-letter** — business correspondence on respect and care instead of ritual politeness: informative subject lines, substance in the first paragraph, boundaries, the do-not-send-on-emotion check, cold emails and job replies. Both skills run in rewrite mode or review-only mode
